name: High Knee
aliases: Running in Place with High Knees
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core braced, and arms bent at 90 degrees at your sides.
Drive one knee rapidly up toward hip height while swinging the opposite arm forward.
Land lightly on the ball of your foot and immediately drive the opposite knee upward.
Continue alternating legs rapidly in a continuous running rhythm for the target duration.
tips: Stay tall through your chest instead of leaning backward to lift your knees higher.
Land softly on the balls of your feet to keep your cadence light and bouncy.
